perspective:
From Jose’s perspective:

- He noticed Patricia seemed more withdrawn than usual at work, and he remembered her as usually vibrant, so he suspected something might be troubling her.
- He asked if she was okay; she said it was “nothing really,” just personal stuff, and thanked him for asking. He offered to listen if she ever needed to talk, and she said she appreciated it.
- During a lunch break, he overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He told her that managing finances can be stressful and mentioned he had been reading about financial planning strategies. She said that could be helpful and admitted she had been overwhelmed with bills lately. He offered to go over budgeting tips together when she felt up to it, and she thanked him and said she’d take him up on it soon.
- After that conversation, he worried he might have overstepped. He told her he hoped she didn’t mind him bringing up financial planning and that he wanted to help, not pry. She said she didn’t think he was prying and was grateful for the offer. He reassured her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend. She said it was good to know she had someone to turn to.
- From that interaction, he sensed Patricia appreciated his concern but preferred to handle her issues privately.
- He later checked in casually, asking about her weekend. She said she was fine and planned a quiet weekend at home. He said he’d probably relax and read, and reminded her he was available if she needed anything or wanted to chat. She thanked him and said she’d keep it in mind.
- He continued to check in with her at work. She said she was busy but handling it, thanked him for checking in, and said his support was great. He offered to help with anything or even just grab a coffee, and she said she’d let him know. He said anytime and that they were all there to help each other.
